source.title: Final report on amending Guidelines on ICT risk and security management (EBA/GL/2025/02)
source.applicability: Official interpretation of DORA Articles 3-5 regarding proportionality, simplified framework application, and management body responsibilities for ICT risk oversight. Specifies requirements for governance structures, accountability, and risk management frameworks.
